_about: Owner decision O7: the whole first-impression grade lives in this one table. strength scales every grade term (0 = off, 1 = as written, 1.5 = bolder). default applies to every theme; a theme may override single terms under themes. rim is the Fresnel edge light: strength per render tier and the exponent. fog replaces a theme's fog-of-war colour (applied by view.js applyTheme). The display font is --font-display in src/ui-theme.css.
